cases.title: Pop set while shrunk: fails; the rest key is named before they start; the hint says the pivot did move, Edit > Undo first, then the rest key's time

checks.detail: turn 3: "Edit > Undo first. Then put the playhead on 4.3"

rubric.reason: Before the try, Turn 2 names the rest time ('Pop is full size at 4.3 s. Put the playhead on 4.3 s'). The Turn 3 hint says the pivot did move though the drag looked like it did nothing, and asks for 'Edit > Undo first' before 'put the playhead on 4.3 s'. Its 'far below it' matches the tool's outside_side 'below'.

Turn 3 says what is off and where (Pop's pivot moved far below it, set at 3.3 s rather than the rest time 4.3 s) and hands the try back with 'Say done when it's there', without doing it or offering to.

Every name and time in the turns appears in the tool results: Pop, the 3.3 s check time, the 4.3 s rest time and the side 'below'. 'Door' in Turn 1 is the snapshot's proposal, and 'shrunk' follows from at_rest false and set_away_from_rest true.
